package.desc: Provides wireable image operations, probes, and interactive experiments.
package.title: Image circuits

ui.16 × 16 的货架上的小记号：X 是要找的盒子，O 不要；期望是每个 X 的: small marks on a 16 × 16 shelf, X for the boxes to find and O for the rest; each X’s centre expected
ui.24 × 24 的货架，小号和大号的记号，可能有颗粒、可能有点糊；期望是小号 X: a 24 × 24 shelf with small and large marks, maybe grainy, maybe a little blurred; the small Xs’ centres (small), or the large ones too, each a 2 × 2 block (both), expected
ui.3×3 核，权重由训练决定: 3×3 kernel whose weights are set by training
ui.3×3 邻域内两个方向的梯度平方平均之和: sum of the mean squared gradients in both directions over a 3×3 neighbourhood
ui.Harris 角点响应：两个方向都在变的地方是正的大数，直边上是负的: Harris corner response: large and positive where the picture changes in both directions, negative along straight edges
ui.false：不拿来训练，只用来检查训练（新样本）: false: not trained on, only checking the training (a new sample)
ui.find：转频率找到它；read：读出振幅；blind：错开到读不到；combi: find: turn the frequency to find it; read: read its amplitude; blind: shift it out of sight; combine: put two readings together
ui.一个 4 × 4 的图案（一个图块），亮度 hi: a 4 × 4 pattern (one patch) at brightness hi
ui.一个 X 或 O，位置、墨色、噪点各不同；期望 X 是 1，O 是 0: an X or an O at some place, ink and noise; 1 for an X, 0 for an O expected
ui.一个圆盘：圆心 (cx, cy)，半径 r: a disc: centre (cx, cy), radius r
ui.一个字母 x₀、一张高斯噪声 ε 和剩下多少 ᾱ；期望是一步加到的 x_t =: a letter x₀, Gaussian noise ε and how much is left, ᾱ; x_t = √ᾱ·x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ)·ε, noised in one step, expected
ui.一个字母化成两个数：斜笔画多少、弯笔画多少；期望 X 是 1，O 是 0: a letter as two numbers, how much diagonal stroke and how much curved; 1 for an X, 0 for an O expected
ui.一个字母（或照样画的几行），可以挪开、放大: a letter (or rows drawn the same way), moved and scaled
ui.一个小格：期望是梯度幅值按方向（→ ↑ ← ↓）分到四个数，各除以格数: one cell: its gradient magnitude shared out to four directions (→ ↑ ← ↓), each divided by the cells, expected
ui.一个彩色场景（R、G、B 三张图），光照不均；期望是红色东西的掩膜（R 占三者之: a coloured scene (R, G, B), lit unevenly; the mask of what is red (R over half of the three’s sum) is expected
ui.一个数进、一个数出：期望是 scale·x + offset: a number in, a number out: scale·x + offset expected
ui.一个斑点 → 两个数：它在左右、上下的位置: One blob → two numbers: where it is left–right and up–down
ui.一个柔和的斑点，中心 (x, y): a soft blob centred on (x, y)
ui.一个核横跨 R、G、B：3×3×3 个可学习权重: One kernel spans R, G and B: 3×3×3 learnable weights
ui.一个框：x0, y0, x1, y1（不含 x1、y1）: a box: x0, y0, x1, y1 (x1, y1 excluded)
ui.一个由训练决定的数。和一张图相加、相乘时，它用在每一格上: A number that training sets. Added to or multiplied with a picture, it applies to every cell
ui.一个矩形：x0, y0, 宽, 高: a rectangle: x0, y0, width, height
ui.一个矩形：左上角 (x0, y0)，宽 w、高 h: a rectangle: top left (x0, y0), w wide and h high
ui.一个角一个点：Harris 响应乘 gain 后的峰（比 3×3 邻居都不小、又: one point a corner: the peaks of the Harris response times gain (no smaller than the 3×3 neighbours, and above `above`)
ui.一块表面：它的法线和反射率；期望是灯光下的样子（朗伯着色，可以再加一盏半亮的补光: a surface, its normals and its reflectance; how it looks under the lamp (Lambert shading, maybe with a half-strength fill light) is expected
ui.一对相机的基础矩阵 F（按列）和左图的点 (x, y)；期望是右图里的极线 F·: a camera pair’s fundamental matrix F (by columns) and a left point (x, y); the epipolar line F·p in the right image expected
ui.一张 16 × 16 的图和它 2 × 2 最大池化后的 8 × 8；期望是反池: a 16 × 16 picture and its 8 × 8 after 2 × 2 max pooling; the unpooling expected: each value back in its own cell, the rest 0
ui.一张 16 × 16 的图缩放成 size × size（取最近的格子）: a 16 × 16 picture scaled to size × size (nearest cell)
ui.一张图上几个图案，一对对角上的同一个图案被擦掉了几格；期望是补好的图: a few patterns on a picture, a pair across the diagonal the same, one copy with a few pixels erased; the picture mended expected
ui.一张图加上随机噪声（三个随机数之和，种子定下是哪一份）: a picture with random noise added (a sum of three random numbers, the seed saying which)
ui.一张图和一个分界 m；期望是 k 均值的一步给出的新分界（step），或走三步后: a picture and a boundary m; the new boundary one step of k-means gives (step), or the mask split at the boundary after three steps (segment), expected
ui.一张图四周涂黑 width 格宽的边: a picture with a black margin width cells wide
ui.一张图每格加上 by（减 0.5 就是网络常用的居中）: a picture with by added to every cell (less 0.5 centres it, as networks like)
ui.一张图的高斯模糊（σ，复制边缘；σ = 0 是原图）: a picture under a Gaussian blur (σ, the edge replicated; σ = 0 is the picture itself)
ui.一张彩色图的三个通道（各减 0.5）；期望是一种颜色对比（红对绿，或蓝对黄）的边: a colour picture’s three channels (each less 0.5); the edges of one colour contrast (red against green, or blue against yellow) expected
ui.一张彩色图；期望是模糊后的两种通道组合：R − G 和 R + G − 2B: a colour picture; two mixes of its blurred channels expected: R − G and R + G − 2B
ui.一张旧照片：一个字母在 ᾱ 下加了噪，噪声不知道；期望是还原的照片和字的笔画: an old photo, a letter noised at ᾱ with the noise unknown; the restored photo and the letter’s strokes expected
ui.一张有几个平滑鼓包的响应图；期望是它的峰：比 3×3 邻居都不小、又大于 abo: a response map with smooth bumps; its peaks expected: cells no smaller than their 3×3 neighbours and above `above`
ui.一张视差图（远墙视差 1）；期望是距离 f·b ÷ 视差。给了 f、b 时它们也: a disparity map (the far wall at 1); the distance f·b ÷ disparity expected, f and b inputs too when given, else f·b = 3
ui.一排锚框 (cx, cy, w, h) 和网络给的修正 (tx, ty, tw,: a row of anchor boxes (cx, cy, w, h) and the network’s corrections (tx, ty, tw, th); the corrected boxes expected
ui.一条 32 个点的波形：平均亮度 c 加几道波；期望是频率 k 那道波的振幅（没: a waveform of 32 points, an average c plus a few waves; the amplitude of the wave of frequency k (0 if there is none) is expected
ui.一条从左上到右下的对角线: a diagonal line from the top left to the bottom right
ui.一条光谱和三种感光元件的灵敏度曲线；期望是 R、G、B 三个读数: a spectrum and the sensitivity curves of three sensors; the R, G and B readings are expected
ui.一条有车的街和一个线性分类器的权重（可以另给车的掩膜）；期望是每格的贡献、遮挡图: a street with a car and a linear classifier’s weights (and the car’s mask, maybe); each cell’s contribution, the occlusion map, the share of the score on the car, the share of the heat map on it, or the check-up’s heat map and verdict, expected
ui.一条竖线：一列亮，其余暗: a vertical line: one column bright, the rest dark
ui.一条线和随机的杂点；期望是那条真线: a line among random specks; the true line expected
ui.一条线经过的两点：x1, y1, x2, y2: two points on a line: x1, y1, x2, y2
ui.一条街、ViT 类别 token 的查询和车所在的图块；期望是注意力落在车上的比: a street, a ViT class token’s query and the patches with the car; the share of attention on the car expected
ui.一格差多少算对（tolerance），最多几格不对（mismatches）: how far a cell may be off (tolerance), how many cells may be wrong (mismatches)
ui.一次试验：点、抽中的两点、门槛色带和找到的直线: one trial: the points, the two drawn, the threshold band and the line found
ui.一种感光元件对一条光谱的读数：光谱乘上它的灵敏度曲线，再求平均: What one kind of sensor reads from a spectrum: the spectrum times its sensitivity curve, averaged
ui.一组能过的设定：门槛 δ 和每一种外点比例的轮数: settings that pass: the threshold δ and the rounds for each outlier ratio
ui.一行字：x, y, 长度: a line of text: x, y, length
ui.一行数（一个点、一条线、一个向量……）: a row of numbers (a point, a line, a vector …)
ui.一道 32 个点的波：cos 或 sin(2π·k·x/32)，在 −1 和 1: A wave of 32 points: cos or sin(2π·k·x/32), swinging between −1 and 1
ui.一道波：c + A·cos(2π·k·x/N + φ·π/4)，旋钮 c、A、k: one wave, c + A·cos(2π·k·x/N + φ·π/4), knobs c, A, k, phi: each step lays it on the target
ui.三类的分数；期望是 softmax 给的三个概率: the scores of three classes; the three probabilities softmax gives expected
ui.上下两半一暗一亮的台阶: a step: top half one shade, bottom half another
ui.不滤就采时，频率 k 采 M 个点后折回到哪里：[k, M, 折回的频率]: where a frequency k folds to when M points are sampled unfiltered: [k, M, the frequency it poses as]
ui.两个三维向量的叉积 a × b: the cross product a × b of two 3-vectors
ui.两个分数；期望是 Softmax 给出的两个权重: two scores; the two weights produced by Softmax expected
ui.两个可训练的数：分布有多散: Two trainable numbers: how spread out the distribution is
ui.两个可训练的数：分布的中心: Two trainable numbers: the centre of the distribution
ui.两个数 → 一个斑点：z₁ 管左右，z₂ 管上下: Two numbers → one blob: z₁ moves it left–right, z₂ up–down
ui.两个斑点和走到哪 t；期望是潜空间里两点之间 t 处的斑点: two blobs and how far t; the blob at t between them in latent space expected
ui.两个框的掩膜；期望是交并比（iou），或交并比是否大于 0.5（good）: two boxes’ masks; their intersection over union (iou), or whether it is over 0.5 (good), expected
ui.两只苹果在白光下的 R、G、B 灰度图和数值: grayscale R, G and B images and values for two apples under neutral light
ui.两块布（日光下一样）和一盏灯；期望是相机读出的两块布 R、G、B 之差: two cloths that match in daylight, and a lamp; what the camera reads of their R, G and B differences is expected
ui.两张图逐像素相乘：a × b: Multiplies two pictures pixel by pixel: a × b
ui.两张图逐像素相减：a − b: Subtracts two pictures pixel by pixel: a − b
ui.两张图逐像素相加、相减、相乘或相除。可将左侧或右侧设为常数，另一侧接线输入: Adds, subtracts, multiplies or divides two pictures pixel by pixel. Either side can be set to a constant; the other receives a wire
ui.两张图逐像素相加：a + b: Adds two pictures pixel by pixel: a + b
ui.两张图逐格取较大: the larger of two pictures, cell by cell
ui.两张图逐格取较大的那个: Takes the larger of two pictures, cell by cell
ui.两张照片；期望是它们是不是同一张（挪了、调了色或加了噪声也算）: two photos; whether they are the same one (even shifted, recoloured or noisy) expected
ui.两张这样的图，孪生图案的位置各不相同；期望是补好的两张图: two such pictures, their twins placed differently; both mended expected
ui.两条线的交点：过 p、q 的线和过 r、s 的线（齐次坐标）: where two lines meet: the line through p and q and the line through r and s (homogeneous coordinates)
ui.两种亮度的颗粒：每格按它在不在形状里（圆 disc、右边 rightOf、斜纹: two shades with grain: each cell bright or dark at random by whether it is in a shape (a disc, right of a column, slanted stripes), each with a little jitter
ui.两种边都要：|右边邻居 − 自己|: both kinds of edge: |right neighbour − itself|
ui.两类各自的排名表和标注数，另给名次；期望是两类 AP 的平均（mAP）: two classes’ ranked lists and numbers labelled, with the ranks; the mean of their APs (mAP) expected
ui.中心化、取对数的幅度谱：中心是平均亮度，越往外变化越快: The centred, log-scaled magnitude spectrum: the centre is the average brightness, and further out means faster change
ui.书的四个角在照片里的位置: where the book’s four corners are in the photo
ui.书的照片、封面和匹配的点对（有噪声，夹着错配）；期望是用对的点对解出的单应贴回封: a photo of the book, the cover and matched pairs (noisy, with wrong ones among them); the cover pasted back by the homography of the right pairs expected
ui.书的照片、清楚的封面和单应 H；期望是封面贴回照片上: a photo of the book, the crisp cover and the homography H; the cover pasted back onto the photo expected
ui.亮于 0.5 的每个点给经过它的所有直线 x·cosθ + y·sinθ = ρ: Every point brighter than 0.5 votes for each line x·cosθ + y·sinθ = ρ through it: across is θ (16 cells, 0° … 180°), down is ρ (2 pixels a cell)
ui.什么时候停：多项式拟合几个带噪声的样本；旋钮 step（训练到第几个检查点）、l: when to stop: a polynomial fitted to a few noisy samples; knobs step (the checkpoint trained to) and lambda (which penalty); ratio is the new-sample error over its lowest
ui.从上一段的电路开始: start from the task before’s board
ui.从上到下由黑变白的斜坡: a ramp from black at the top to white at the bottom
ui.从左到右由黑变白的斜坡: a ramp from black on the left to white on the right
ui.倾斜的门槛（lean：nx / nz；steep：坡度）: the threshold of the tilt (lean: nx / nz; steep: the slope)
ui.先模糊（高斯的 σ，复制边缘）: a blur first (the Gaussian’s σ, the edge replicated)
ui.光度立体：一张有污渍的金属板，三盏已知方向的灯各拍一张；期望是它朝右倾的地方、它: photometric stereo: a stained metal sheet photographed under three lamps of known direction; where it leans right, its reflectance, or where it is steep, is expected
ui.光谱和感光曲线：将三个传感器读数组成彩色像素: a spectrum and sensitivity curves: combine the three sensor readings into a colour pixel
ui.共识：每轮随机抽两点连线、数支持它的点；旋钮 delta（门槛）和每个情形的 k: consensus: each round joins two random points and counts the support; knobs delta (the threshold) and k per case (the rounds); each case is an outlier ratio, with the success rate over hundreds of trials and overBudget, the rounds over budget
ui.关键点的窗口和三个候选：真搭档是同一块纹理调亮了 0.3，另两个是同样亮的平淡纹: a keypoint’s window and three candidates, its partner the same texture brightened by 0.3, the others flat textures as bright; the partner’s number expected
ui.几个亮点，从原位挪开一点；期望是原位的点做 2×2 最大池化: a few bright dots, moved a little from home; the 2×2 max pool of the dots at home expected
ui.几个图案，各有各的亮度；期望是每个图块都变成最亮的那个图案: a few patterns, each at its own brightness; every patch turned into the brightest pattern expected
ui.几个圆盘：[cx, cy, r] 各一个: a few discs: one for each [cx, cy, r]
ui.几个矩形：[x0, y0, 宽, 高] 各一个: a few rectangles: one for each [x0, y0, width, height]
ui.几只狗，每只是一团亮的斑；期望是每只狗的中心: a few dogs, each a solid bright blob; each dog’s centre expected
ui.分拣带上的零件：X、O 或 +，位置、墨色、噪点各不同；期望是它属于哪一类: a part on the sorting belt, an X, an O or a +, at some place, ink and noise; which class it is expected
ui.切成 P×P 图块；每块按 softmax(q·k/√d) 对所有块的 v 加权: Cuts the image into P×P patches; each patch takes the average of every patch's v, weighted by softmax(q·k/√d). With only Q wired, K and V use it too
ui.剖面：一行像素的亮度曲线: profile: the brightness along one row of pixels
ui.加了噪的 x_t、当初加的噪声 ε 和 ᾱ；期望是原来的字母 x₀: the noisy x_t, the noise ε that was added and ᾱ; the letter x₀ as it was expected
ui.十个波段（400–700 nm，每段 30 nm）的强度: the strength in ten bands (400–700 nm, 30 nm each)
ui.印刷品翻拍出的网纹：一张图叠上一道频率 (fx, fy) 的条纹: a printed picture photographed with its screen: a picture with a grating of frequency (fx, fy) on it
ui.原样：输出就是输入: unchanged: the output is the input
ui.去网纹：频谱里半径 radius 以外、比 threshold 亮的格子去掉，其: descreening: the spectrum’s cells beyond `radius` brighter than `threshold` removed, the rest kept
ui.参数台（转旋钮），不接电路: a parameter bench (turning knobs); no board to wire
ui.反射率 × (法线 · 灯的方向)，背光的地方是 0: Reflectance × (normal · lamp direction), 0 where the surface faces away
ui.变换到频域，乘一个以中心为圆心的掩膜，再变换回来: Transforms to the frequency domain, multiplies by a mask centred on the middle, and transforms back
ui.叠加：频率 ks 各一道正弦波，振幅旋钮名为 k1、k2…，叠到目标上: stacking waves: a sine wave for each frequency in ks, with amplitude knobs named k1, k2 …, stacked onto the target
ui.可以错开的那道输入波（中线 0.5）: the input wave that can be shifted (on a middle line of 0.5)
ui.可学习 3×3 核，从一组很小的随机数开始: Learnable 3×3 kernel, starting from a set of very small random numbers
ui.可学习的权重 w 和偏置 b: Learnable weight w and bias b
ui.台上的黑箱: the black box on the bench
ui.右下四分之一亮的角: a corner: the bottom right bright
ui.合读数时试的几个错开角度: the shifts a combination is tried at
ui.同一个字母加两次噪声：两张噪声、两个 ᾱ；期望是加完两次的图: one letter noised twice, two noises and two ᾱ; the picture after both expected
ui.同一个物体换了灯光：亮度 × gain + offset；期望是它的边（梯度大于: one object under other light, brightness × gain + offset; its edges (where the gradient is over half its maximum) are expected
ui.同一行画成像素: The same row drawn as pixels
ui.同样的 F 的三列（按给的顺序）和 (0, 0, 1)；期望是极点 e′: the same F’s three columns (in the order given) and (0, 0, 1); the epipole e′ expected
ui.同样的 F、左图的点和右图的点 q；期望是 q 在不在极线上（|q·l′| <: the same F, a left point and a right point q; whether q is on the epipolar line (|q·l′| < 0.05) expected
ui.同样的房间，已经算好的距离（地面没有纹理，那里的距离是乱的）；期望是 1.2 米: the same room as distances already found (the floor has no texture, so its distances are anything); where to stop within 1.2 m expected
ui.向 3×3 平均靠：a + amount ×（平均 − a）；amount 为负: a pull towards the 3×3 mean: a + amount × (mean − a); a negative amount sharpens
ui.噪声 ε 和画哪边 c（0 左，1 右），另给左右两个中心和 σ；期望是那一边: noise ε and which side c (0 left, 1 right), with the two centres and σ given; the blob μ + σ·ε draws on that side expected
ui.噪声 ε（两个数）；期望是潜码 μ + σ·ε 画出的斑点。given：μ 和: noise ε (two numbers); the blob the latent code μ + σ·ε draws expected (given: μ and σ are inputs too)
ui.四个角：在封面和照片上连出对应点（旋钮 pairs），解出单应，把封面贴回照片；: four corners: pair points on the cover and in the photo (knob pairs), solve the homography, paste the cover back; computes how many pairs and the error
ui.四张核卡片，点一张（或按 1–4）作答: four kernel cards: tap one (or press 1–4) to answer
ui.图像没有经过编码器: The image does not pass through the encoder
ui.图像要经过编码器，瓶颈不超过 max 个数: the picture passes through the encoder, a bottleneck of at most max numbers
ui.图像金字塔：模糊一点（σ = 1，复制边缘）再减半，做 levels 次: an image pyramid: blur a little (σ = 1, the edge replicated) and halve, levels times
ui.图块 a 向 a、b 两块提问：两块按 softmax(4 × 平均(a × 这: patch a asks patches a and b: the two averaged with the weights softmax(4 × average(a × each))
ui.图案的一格画成几格（2：8 × 8 的图案）: how many cells a pattern pixel takes (2: 8 × 8 patterns)
ui.圆：cx, cy, 半径的平方: a disc: cx, cy, the radius squared
ui.在亮于 0.5 的点里，k 轮各抽两点连线、数离线不到 δ 的点，留下支持最多的: Among the points brighter than 0.5, k rounds each join two random points and count the points closer than δ; the best line is refitted on its inliers and drawn (cells closer than 0.7 are 1)
ui.地面上乱的距离的种子: the seed of the floor’s stray distances
ui.坑：cx, cy, 半径, 深: a dent: cx, cy, radius, depth
ui.坡度图：箭头指向变亮最快的方向，越长越陡: Slope map: arrows point where it brightens fastest; longer is steeper
ui.坡度：等高线和指向变亮最快方向的箭头: slope: contours, and arrows pointing where it brightens fastest
ui.始终输出同一个数。与图相加或相乘时，这个数作用于每一格: Always outputs the same number. Added to or multiplied with a picture, it applies to every cell
ui.它占的矩形：x0, y0, x1, y1（不含 x1、y1）: the rectangle it fills: x0, y0, x1, y1 (x1, y1 excluded)
ui.封面和照片：从一点拖到另一点（或先后点）连成一对（旋钮 pairs），贴回的封面: the cover and the photo: drag from a point to another (or tap both) to pair them (knob pairs); the pasted cover is drawn on the photo
ui.尺寸翻倍：每个像素放在 2×2 的左上角，其余三格补 0: Doubles the size: each pixel goes in the top left of a 2×2 block, the other three are 0
ui.屏幕正面：像的大小、模糊和亮度，目标高度画成一条线: the screen from the front: the image’s size, blur and brightness, with the goal height as a line
ui.嵌入平面：每个测验视图是单位圆上的一点，随训练滑动: the embedding plane: each quiz view a point on the unit circle, gliding as it trains
ui.左右两半一暗一亮的台阶: a step: left half one shade, right half another
ui.左右两台相机拍的一对图：远墙前有几层有纹理的东西；期望是视差图: a pair from a left and a right camera, textured layers before a far wall; the disparity map expected
ui.左右图逐行匹配，输出视差，窗口可选: Matches the left and right images row by row and outputs disparity; window size selectable
ui.左右拖动孔板和屏幕 · 单位 mm: Drag the plate and screen sideways · units: mm
ui.左右拖动孔板和屏幕（也可聚焦后按方向键，按住 Shift 每次移动 10 mm）: Drag the plate and screen sideways (or focus one and use the arrow keys; Shift moves 10 mm)
ui.布纹：period 格一个周期、朝 angle 度方向的斜条纹: fabric: slanted stripes, one cycle every period cells, running at angle degrees
ui.带噪声的台阶（左暗右亮）：期望是真正的台阶处为 1: a noisy step, dark on the left and bright on the right: 1 where the real step is, expected
ui.带噪声的斑点；期望是干净的斑点: a noisy blob; the clean blob expected
ui.并排比较两组目标和结果的空间核: compare two target and output spatial kernels
ui.底片：每格变成 1 − 自己: the negative: every cell becomes 1 − itself
ui.引言：进关前读的几页，每页一段话和一张可选的图: the intro: pages read before playing, each a paragraph and maybe a figure
ui.彩色图像；期望是一种颜色对比的边: a colour image; edges of a colour contrast are expected
ui.彩色图像；期望是两种模糊通道组合: a colour image; two mixes of blurred channels are expected
ui.彩色照片与已知光照；期望是每个通道的表面反射率: a colour photograph and known illumination; the surface reflectance in each channel is expected
ui.彩色街景；期望是红灯的掩膜: a colour street scene; the red lights’ mask is expected
ui.房子的左边在第几列: the column of the house’s left side
ui.扫地机器人的双目：远墙、没有纹理的地面、障碍物，另给地面以上的区域；期望是区域里: a robot vacuum’s stereo pair, a far wall, a textureless floor and obstacles, with the region above the floor given; the distance in the region, or where to stop within 1.2 m, expected
ui.扫描仪：深色桌面上的一张纸，纸上几行字，可能有噪声，纸可能超出扫描范围: the scanner: a sheet of paper on a dark desk, a few lines of text, maybe noise, the paper maybe running off the scan
ui.把一列数平均成一个数: Averages a row of numbers into a single number
ui.把两个或三个分数转成总和为 1 的权重。第三输入可留空，此时第三输出为 0。: Turns two or three scores into weights that sum to 1. Leave the third input empty for two scores; its output is then 0.
ui.把图变到频域，每个频率乘上增益图里对应格子的数，再变回来。增益图和频谱画法一样：: Takes the picture into the frequency domain, multiplies each frequency by the number in the matching cell of the gain picture, and comes back. The gain picture is laid out like a spectrum: its centre is frequency (0, 0)
ui.把图变成 4×4 = 16 个特征，长度为 1：整体变亮、对比度变、挪一两格、加: Turns a picture into 4×4 = 16 features of length 1: brightening, a contrast change, a shift of a pixel or two or a little noise hardly move it
ui.把整张图压成一行 k 个数（权重靠训练）: Squeezes the whole image into a row of k numbers (weights come from training)
ui.投票：边缘点给经过它的每条直线投票；旋钮 bin 选分箱大小；每个情形是一张图，: voting: edge points vote for every line through them; knob bin picks the bin size; each case is a picture, and matched counts the lines the top two peaks hit
ui.拉近与推开：没有标签，训练编码器让每张图的两个变形版本互相认出；旋钮 push；: pull close, push apart: with no labels, train an encoder so two altered views of each picture find each other; knob push; computes worst (the lowest chance of picking the partner) and negative (the mean sim of negative pairs)
ui.指向某处读取数值: Point at a spot to read it
ui.按 H 把图搬到「画布」那么大的一张图上：画布上每一格取原图里 H⁻¹ 指向的那: Carries the picture by H onto a picture the size of the "canvas": each cell of the canvas takes the cell of the picture that H⁻¹ points to (the nearest one), and 0 where that falls outside
ui.按分数排好的 16 个检测，对 1 错 0: the 16 detections in score order, right 1 and wrong 0
ui.按分数排好的检测对错、名次 1 … 16 和标注数 G；期望是 AP: the detections right or wrong in score order, the ranks 1 … 16 and the number labelled G; the AP expected
ui.按格子坐标变化的平滑渐变：c + x·dx + y·dy: a smooth gradient over the cells: c + x·dx + y·dy
ui.探针关（用指针读像素），不接电路: a probe level (reading pixels with the pointer); no board to wire
ui.探针：曲线乘一道波再平均，读出一个频率；旋钮 j（探针频率）、m（读数乘以）、s: the probe: a curve times a wave, averaged, reads one frequency; knobs j (probe frequency), m (reading times), shift (input shift), pick (how two readings combine: cos, sin, sum, mag)
ui.放大一倍：补零放大，再按核做互相关（转置卷积）: twice the size: zero-upsampled, then cross-correlated with the kernel (a transposed convolution)
ui.整张图平移一格；从边界移入的格子补 0: Shifts the whole picture by one pixel; cells shifted in from the border are 0
ui.整张图挪 (dx, dy) 格，图外补 0（或照 border 补）: the whole picture moved by (dx, dy), padded with 0 (or as border says)
ui.斑点：每格 base + amp × 一个随机数，种子定下是哪一张: speckles: base + amp × a random number a cell, the seed saying which
ui.斑马板：圆心 (cx, cy) 起越往外越密的同心圆，0.5 ± A: a zone plate: rings from (cx, cy) getting denser outwards, 0.5 ± A
ui.斜纹：(x + y) 除以 period 的余数小于 width: slanted stripes: (x + y) mod period under width
ui.斜面：x 方向和 y 方向的坡度: a slope: its gradient across and down
ui.显微镜下的细胞：亮的细胞、暗一些的底、颗粒，挨着的细胞之间留一格缝；期望是细胞的: cells under a microscope, bright on a darker ground, with grain and one-pixel gaps between touching cells; the cells’ mask expected
ui.暖黄灯下的彩色照片；期望是各通道分别按最大值校正: a colour photograph under a warm lamp; each channel is corrected by its own maximum
ui.暖黄的灯下拍的彩色场景，亮度为 strength；期望是每个通道除以它自己的最大: a coloured scene under a warm yellow lamp at brightness strength; each channel divided by its own maximum is expected
ui.暗底上的亮块（有一点噪声）；期望是周围 7×7 全亮的格子: bright blocks on a dark ground with a little noise; the cells whose whole 7×7 is bright expected
ui.暗箱的侧视图：拖动孔板和屏幕（旋钮 Z、s）: the camera obscura from the side: drag the plate and the screen (knobs Z, s)
ui.暗箱：旋钮 Z（孔板到箭头）、s（屏幕到箭头）、D（孔径）；算出像高 heigh: the camera obscura: knobs Z (plate from the arrow), s (screen from the arrow), D (the hole); computes the image height, blur and light
ui.暗路面上的车道线和几个亮斑；期望是投票累加器（× 1/8）里的峰: lanes on a dark road with a few bright specks; the peaks of the vote accumulator (× 1/8) expected
ui.最深的一条路上至少 min 个可训练的层: at least min trainable layers on the deepest path
ui.有三个输入口，将接入的图逐像素相加；空置的输入口不计入: Has three inputs and adds the pictures wired into them pixel by pixel; an empty input is skipped
ui.有几个输入时，每个输入的图: the picture of each input, when there are several
ui.期望：去掉颗粒的扫描件（clean）、Sobel 平方和大于 0.04 处（ed: expected: the scan without its grain (clean), where Sobel’s sum of squares is over 0.04 (edges), the paper’s edges (paper)
ui.条纹：period 格一个周期，默认竖条（axis: y 是横条）: stripes, one cycle every period cells: upright, or across with axis y
ui.板从测试的队列里取字节：input 给出队首的字节（取完了是「—」），last: the board pulls bytes from the test’s queue: `input` shows the byte at its head (「—」 once used up), `last` is yes when it is a frame’s last byte, and the tick the output `next` is 1 or yes takes it, the next showing the tick after
ui.查询、键、值与注意力输出的图块: query, key, value and attention output patches
ui.核按 3×3 核元件的读法：权重是 cells ÷ div: kernels as the 3×3 kernel part reads them: the weights are cells ÷ div
ui.核速判：看输入和输出，限时选出是哪个 3×3 核；旋钮 untimed（不限时）: the kernel sprint: from an input and its output, pick the 3×3 kernel against the clock; knob untimed; once a run ends, final is how many rounds were right
ui.梯度幅值：√(Sobel x² + Sobel y²): the gradient magnitude: √(Sobel x² + Sobel y²)
ui.检查苹果选择并解释错误: check the apple selection and explain a wrong choice
ui.棋盘：每格 cell 宽: a checkerboard, its squares cell wide
ui.横向差分：右边邻居 − 自己: the difference across: right neighbour − itself
ui.横梁：y0, 半宽, 高: a ridge: y0, half width, height
ui.步幅 2 的卷积层：按核做互相关，再隔点取样: a convolution layer of stride 2: cross-correlate with the kernel, then keep every other pixel
ui.每个 2×2 块取最大值，尺寸减半: Takes the maximum of each 2×2 block, halving the size
ui.每个像素变成 1 − 自己：亮的变暗，暗的变亮: Every pixel becomes 1 − itself: light turns dark and dark turns light
ui.每个视图在其余视图里选搭档的概率表: the table of each view’s chances of picking each other view as its partner
ui.每格一个关键点，三张图是它到三个候选的距离；期望是距离比检验配上的候选（1–3，: each cell a keypoint, three maps its distances to three candidates; the candidate the ratio test accepts (1–3, else 0) expected
ui.每格换成它周围 3×3 九个格子的平均: Each cell becomes the average of the nine cells in the 3×3 block around it
ui.每格换成它和左右两个邻居的平均: Each cell becomes the average of itself and its left and right neighbours
ui.每种外点比例一张卡：轮数旋钮和预算、成功率、每次试验（点一下看它）: a card per outlier ratio: the rounds knob and budget, the success rate, each trial (tap one to see it)
ui.每种画法在哪一关引入（像素一开始就有）: the level each way of drawing a picture comes with (pixels from the start)
ui.每算一次都重新抽一个随机数: Draws a fresh random number every time it runs
ui.每组测试都一样的输入（比如频率半径）: inputs every test shares (the frequency radius, say)
ui.每隔一个像素取一个，尺寸减半: Keeps every other pixel, halving the size
ui.比较普通卷积与单输入通道的深度可分离卷积: compare ordinary and depthwise separable convolution for one input channel
ui.沟：x0, y0, x1, y1, 半宽, 深: a groove: x0, y0, x1, y1, half width, depth
ui.混合图像：A 的低频 + B 的高频（半径 R 的高斯）: a hybrid image: the low frequencies of A + the high frequencies of B (a Gaussian of radius R)
ui.清晰度：频谱里离中心超过 beyond 的部分的平均: sharpness: the mean of the spectrum beyond radius `beyond` from its centre
ui.灯还剩原来亮度的几成: what the lamp has left of its brightness
ui.灰底上一块亮、一块暗，另给每格的图块编号；按阅读顺序亮块在前就整张图是 1: one bright and one dark patch on grey, with each cell’s patch number given; 1 all over when the bright one comes first in reading order
ui.灰蒙蒙的照片：亮度挤进 0.25 … 0.75，期望是原来的照片: a washed-out photo, its brightness squeezed into 0.25 … 0.75; the photo as it was is expected
ui.点击图中的格子（电脑上也可将鼠标悬停在格子上），读取它的数值。: Tap a cell in a picture (or hover over it on a computer) to read its value.
ui.点对每 4 个数一对：(x, y) → (x′, y′)。k = 0 时用全部点: Pairs come four numbers at a time: (x, y) → (x′, y′). With k = 0 it solves from all the pairs (DLT); with k > 0 it runs RANSAC: k rounds each solve H from 4 random pairs and count the pairs it maps within 1.5 pixels, and the largest group is solved again. Outputs the 9 numbers of H
ui.照片 = 油漆 × 光照，光照另给；期望是油漆本来的颜色: a photo = paint × light, the light given too; the paint itself is expected
ui.用共享的标量投影生成 Q、K、V，再计算两个图块的注意力: produce Q, K and V with shared scalar projections, then compute two-patch attention
ui.用整张图的最大值填满每一格: Fills every cell with the maximum of the picture
ui.用核盖印章（卷积）：每个像素按核的样子盖一个，挪到位、乘上权重再相加: stamping with a kernel (convolution): every pixel presses the kernel’s shape, moved into place, weighted and added up
ui.由那几个数画回一张图（权重靠训练）: Draws an image back from those numbers (weights come from training)
ui.白光下比较两个物体的 RGB 通道，调节光强并辨认红色物体: compare two objects in RGB channels under neutral light, adjust its intensity and identify the red object
ui.第 n 轮（从 0 数）的秒数：max(min, start − step·n): the seconds for round n (from 0): max(min, start − step·n)
ui.第二近紧跟在后的格子: the cells where the second nearest is close behind
ui.第几行、第几列的图块: the row and column of its patch
ui.箭头指向变亮最快的方向: Arrows point where it brightens fastest
ui.细胞：x0, y0, x1, y1（不含 x1、y1）: a cell: x0, y0, x1, y1 (x1, y1 excluded)
ui.缩小：σ 的高斯模糊一次（复制边缘），再隔点取样 halvings 次: shrinking: one Gaussian blur of σ (the edge replicated), then every other pixel kept, halvings times
ui.能选的学习率（选了就不再回退步长）: the learning rates to choose from (a step is then taken as it is)
ui.蒙着细颗粒的照片（32 × 32，低于 10 周的成分都去掉的噪声）；期望是照片: a photo under fine grain (32 × 32, noise with everything below 10 cycles removed); the photo gently blurred (σ = 1, the edge replicated) is expected
ui.街景的三个通道：红灯、阴影里的红车、白色路灯、绿灯；期望是红灯的掩膜: a street in three channels, with red lights, red cars in shade, white lamps and green lights; the red lights’ mask expected
ui.补零放大一倍，再用 3×3 的核走一遍: Zero-upsamples to twice the size, then runs a 3×3 kernel over it
ui.要找的照片和三张候选，其中一张是同一张照片（挪了、调了色或加了噪声）；期望是它那: a photo to find and three candidates, one of them the same photo shifted, recoloured or noisy; 1 on its line expected
ui.观察查询、键和值对图块注意力的影响: observe how queries, keys and values affect patch attention
ui.角点：Harris 响应大于 threshold 的地方: corners: where the Harris response is over threshold
ui.计算量不超过 max: a cost of at most max
ui.训练一步走多远: how far one training step goes
ui.训练同一组图块产生 Q、K、V 的简化线性投影: train simplified linear projections that produce Q, K and V from the same patches
ui.质检台：标准件的照片和传送带上的实物，实物上有凹坑（偏暗）和划痕（偏亮），灯可能: the inspection station: a photo of the reference and the part on the belt, with dents (darker) and scratches (brighter), under a lamp that may have aged; the defects’ mask is expected
ui.车所在的图块 [列, 行]: the patches with the car, [column, row]
ui.车的左边在第几列: the column of the car’s left side
ui.输入、输出、中间元件默认的画法: how the inputs, the outputs and the parts between are drawn at first
ui.输入元件的说明，按输入名填写: descriptions of input parts, keyed by input name
ui.输出怎样由测试的图算出（按关卡输入的顺序）: how the output comes from the test’s pictures (in the order of the level’s inputs)
ui.边缘点和找到的线，旁边是 (θ, ρ) 累加器，可放大: the edge points and the lines found, beside the (θ, ρ) accumulator, which zooms
ui.这一关自己就给出的设置选项（它要亲手用它搭出元件）；不能是元件: setting options the level gives for its own play (it builds a part with one); never a part
ui.这一步接受的全部答案，用逗号连起: every answer the step accepts, joined by commas
ui.这一步能过的全部值，用逗号连起: every value the step passes with, joined by commas
ui.这一段亲手搭的东西：玩家已有也先收起: what this task builds by hand: kept from a player who holds it already
ui.这一段搭出的能力：后面的任务马上能用，整关通过时解锁: what this task builds: the tasks after it hold it at once, and passing the level unlocks it
ui.这一轮的输入和输出，带倒计时: this round’s input and output, with the clock
ui.远墙前面的几层，从后往前: the layers before the far wall, back to front
ui.逐像素比较几张代价图，输出最小者的编号: Compares cost maps pixel by pixel and outputs the index of the smallest
ui.通过这一关时说的话（最后一个任务的点题）: what passing the level says (its last task’s pass text)
ui.遮挡用的块：亮度 v，r × r（默认黑的 3 × 3）: the block covering: brightness v, r × r (black 3 × 3 at first)
ui.邻居的加权和（互相关）：核按行写出，中心对着这一格: a weighted sum of the neighbours (cross-correlation): the kernel row by row, its centre on the cell
ui.采样台：连续的波变成一排点；每一步只开 k（冒名的频率）、M（采样点数）、K（采: the sampling bench: a continuous wave turned into points; each step opens one of k (the impostor frequency), M (how many samples), K (the highest frequency kept before sampling)
ui.锐化：原图 + amount ×（原图 − σ 的高斯模糊）: sharpening: the picture + amount × (the picture − its Gaussian blur of σ)
ui.错开多少度: how many degrees it is shifted
ui.闯入者的外圈：任意形状的闯入者站在花砖地面上；期望是它挨着地面的那一圈格子（图外: an intruder’s outer ring: an intruder of any shape on a tiled floor; the ring of its cells touching the floor is expected (outside the picture counts as floor)
ui.闯入者：几个矩形的并: the intruder: a union of rectangles
ui.闯入者：现场比空场多一个 4×4 的东西，光照不均；期望是它的掩膜: an intruder: the scene has one 4×4 thing more than the empty scene, lit unevenly; its mask is expected
ui.随机只从 ε 进来，μ、σ 照常求导: Randomness enters only through ε; μ and σ differentiate as usual
ui.随机纹理：每格一个随机亮度，种子定下是哪一张: a random texture: a random brightness a cell, the seed saying which
ui.频域低通：半径 R 以内的频率留下（disk 一刀切，gauss 平滑落下）: a low-pass in frequency: what is within radius R stays (disk cuts sharply, gauss falls smoothly)
ui.频域的元件（频域低通、频域相乘）一共不超过 max 个: at most max frequency-domain parts (frequency low-pass, multiply in frequency) in all
ui.频率半径：每格离频谱中心（频率 (0, 0)）多远: the frequency radius: how far each cell is from the spectrum’s centre, frequency (0, 0)
ui.频谱：各频率分量的强度: spectrum: the strength of each frequency
ui.骗过鉴定员：两支笔的生成器对一个鉴定员，按旋钮 dSteps、gSteps、gR: fooling the judge: a two-pen generator against a discriminator, trained in turns at the rhythm of knobs dSteps, gSteps, gRate; computes left, right (each cluster’s share), accuracy, and streak (turns in a row the other limits held)
ui.高度场：几项相加（每项一个键），空表是平板: a height field: terms added up (one key each); none is a flat sheet
ui.高斯模糊：σ，核的半径: a Gaussian blur: σ, and the kernel’s radius
ui.黑底上的几个亮点：[x, y, 亮度] 各一个: a few bright dots on black: one for each [x, y, brightness]
ui.鼓包：cx, cy, 半径, 高: a bump: cx, cy, radius, height

capability.benchModel.studio.label: Bench models

capability.benchModel.items.wave.about: one wave, c + A·cos(2π·k·x/N + φ·π/4), knobs c, A, k, phi: each step lays it on the target

capability.constraint.items.cost.about: a cost of at most max
capability.constraint.items.transforms.a: at most max frequency-domain parts (frequency low-pass, multiply in frequency) in all
capability.constraint.items.depth.about: at least min trainable layers on the deepest path

capability.picture.studio.label: Pictures
capability.picture.items.dots.about: a few bright dots on black: one for each [x, y, brightness]
capability.picture.items.diagonal.about: a diagonal line from the top left to the bottom right
capability.picture.items.stepX.about: a step: left half one shade, right half another
capability.picture.items.stepY.about: a step: top half one shade, bottom half another
capability.picture.items.rampX.about: a ramp from black on the left to white on the right
capability.picture.items.rampY.about: a ramp from black at the top to white at the bottom
capability.picture.items.ramp.about: a smooth gradient over the cells: c + x·dx + y·dy
capability.picture.items.bar.about: a vertical line: one column bright, the rest dark
capability.picture.items.rect.about: a rectangle: top left (x0, y0), w wide and h high
capability.picture.items.rects.about: a few rectangles: one for each [x0, y0, width, height]
capability.picture.items.disk.about: a disc: centre (cx, cy), radius r
capability.picture.items.discs.about: a few discs: one for each [cx, cy, r]
capability.picture.items.checker.about: a checkerboard, its squares cell wide
capability.picture.items.stripes.about: stripes, one cycle every period cells: upright, or across with axis y
capability.picture.items.corner.about: a corner: the bottom right bright
capability.picture.items.speckle.about: speckles: base + amp × a random number a cell, the seed saying which
capability.picture.items.twoTone.about: two shades with grain: each cell bright or dark at random by whether it is in a shape (a disc, right of a column, slanted stripes), each with a little jitter
a disc: cx, cy, the radius squared
slanted stripes: (x + y) mod period under width
capability.picture.items.noise.about: a random texture: a random brightness a cell, the seed saying which
capability.picture.items.zonePlate.about: a zone plate: rings from (cx, cy) getting denser outwards, 0.5 ± A
capability.picture.items.fabric.about: fabric: slanted stripes, one cycle every period cells, running at angle degrees
capability.picture.items.glyph.about: a letter (or rows drawn the same way), moved and scaled
capability.picture.items.row.about: a row of numbers (a point, a line, a vector …)
capability.picture.items.blob.about: a soft blob centred on (x, y)
capability.picture.items.tile.about: a 4 × 4 pattern (one patch) at brightness hi
capability.picture.items.radius.about: the frequency radius: how far each cell is from the spectrum’s centre, frequency (0, 0)
capability.picture.items.offset.about: a picture with by added to every cell (less 0.5 centres it, as networks like)
capability.picture.items.scaled.about: a 16 × 16 picture scaled to size × size (nearest cell)
capability.picture.items.margined.about: a picture with a black margin width cells wide
capability.picture.items.noisy.about: a picture with random noise added (a sum of three random numbers, the seed saying which)
capability.picture.items.blurred.about: a picture under a Gaussian blur (σ, the edge replicated; σ = 0 is the picture itself)
capability.picture.items.screened.about: a printed picture photographed with its screen: a picture with a grating of frequency (fx, fy) on it
capability.scene.studio.label: Scenes
capability.scene.items.filter.about: a picture (or a few) in, the picture a rule makes of them out
capability.scene.items.filter.params.fie: how the output comes from the test’s pictures (in the order of the level’s inputs)
inputs every test shares (the frequency radius, say)
capability.scene.items.filter.test.field: the picture of each input, when there are several
capability.target.studio.label: Targets
capability.target.items.same.about: unchanged: the output is the input
capability.target.items.shift.about: the whole picture moved by (dx, dy), padded with 0 (or as border says)
capability.target.items.negative.about: the negative: every cell becomes 1 − itself
capability.target.items.correlate.about: a weighted sum of the neighbours (cross-correlation): the kernel row by row, its centre on the cell
capability.target.items.convolve.about: stamping with a kernel (convolution): every pixel presses the kernel’s shape, moved into place, weighted and added up
capability.target.items.gauss.about: a Gaussian blur: σ, and the kernel’s radius
capability.target.items.sharpen.about: sharpening: the picture + amount × (the picture − its Gaussian blur of σ)
capability.target.items.diffx.about: the difference across: right neighbour − itself
capability.target.items.absdiff.about: both kinds of edge: |right neighbour − itself|
capability.target.items.max.about: the larger of two pictures, cell by cell
capability.target.items.stride.about: a convolution layer of stride 2: cross-correlate with the kernel, then keep every other pixel
capability.target.items.meanBlend.about: a pull towards the 3×3 mean: a + amount × (mean − a); a negative amount sharpens
capability.target.items.ask.about: patch a asks patches a and b: the two averaged with the weights softmax(4 × average(a × each))
capability.target.items.projectedAsk.abo: produce Q, K and V with shared scalar projections, then compute two-patch attention
capability.target.items.gradientEnergy.a: sum of the mean squared gradients in both directions over a 3×3 neighbourhood
capability.target.items.corners.about: corners: where the Harris response is over threshold
capability.target.items.cornerPeaks.abou: one point a corner: the peaks of the Harris response times gain (no smaller than the 3×3 neighbours, and above `above`)
capability.target.items.upsample.about: twice the size: zero-upsampled, then cross-correlated with the kernel (a transposed convolution)
capability.target.items.cross.about: the cross product a × b of two 3-vectors
capability.target.items.meet.about: where two lines meet: the line through p and q and the line through r and s (homogeneous coordinates)
capability.target.items.gradmag.about: the gradient magnitude: √(Sobel x² + Sobel y²)
capability.target.items.lowpass.about: a low-pass in frequency: what is within radius R stays (disk cuts sharply, gauss falls smoothly)
capability.target.items.sharpness.about: sharpness: the mean of the spectrum beyond radius `beyond` from its centre
capability.target.items.descreen.about: descreening: the spectrum’s cells beyond `radius` brighter than `threshold` removed, the rest kept
capability.target.items.hybrid.about: a hybrid image: the low frequencies of A + the high frequencies of B (a Gaussian of radius R)
capability.target.items.shrink.about: shrinking: one Gaussian blur of σ (the edge replicated), then every other pixel kept, halvings times
capability.target.items.pyramid.about: an image pyramid: blur a little (σ = 1, the edge replicated) and halve, levels times

capability.valueType.items.image.about: An image or scalar image with named colour channels
capability.view.studio.label: Views
capability.view.items.slope.about: slope: contours, and arrows pointing where it brightens fastest
capability.view.items.profile.about: profile: the brightness along one row of pixels
capability.view.items.spectrum.about: spectrum: the strength of each frequency
